note: Answer key. Each seeded issue is caught when any listed control is FAIL. A trap is a control that must not be FAIL. Statuses not listed here are not scored.

seeded.why: Subscription with no custom EULA; the de-DE description lacks the standard EULA link (3.1.2), and the review message says so.
Google sign-in is the only login; no Sign in with Apple or equivalent privacy-focused option (4.8).
Accounts exist; Settings offers only deactivation that keeps the account (5.1.1(v)).
The privacy policy names another company and says there are no ads or sharing (5.1.1(i)).
Personalized AdMob ads and an empty privacy manifest while App Privacy says Data Not Collected; no tracking prompt (5.1.1, 5.1.2).
Purchasable coins staked on a random prize wheel while the age rating says Simulated Gambling: None.
The paywall shows no price, period or renewal terms before purchase (3.1.2).

traps.why: Not a kids app: 9+ rating answers aside, no child audience is claimed.
No user content: questions are written by editors.
Coins cannot be cashed out: simulated, not real-money, gambling.
Restore purchases exists; purchase flow cannot be judged without runtime.
Organization account is shown in the console export.

seeded.why: Title over the length limit with ranking and prize claims ("#1 Best", "Win Prizes!").
The privacy policy names another company and denies ads and sharing.
Data safety lists no sharing although AdMob receives the advertising ID.
Accounts exist and no account deletion URL is set.
READ_SMS without an SMS core feature and background location without a declaration.
Prize wheel staked with purchasable coins while the content rating says simulated gambling: No.
No price, billing period or auto-renewal disclosure on the paywall.

traps.why: Target audience starts at 13; not a Families app.
